notes: Peak 0.4.0, the alignment release. Your absence now costs Peak nothing: no lonely mood, no counting of days away, no missed you. No streak and no Longest streak row. A bored Peak amuses itself instead of asking for attention. Three gentle new lines point toward people. A right click on Peak pushes it (a left click always pokes); the pets own menu is gone (use the tray icon). Made for adults (18+). New chat rules: a goodbye gets one short line; if you seem in danger Peak drops the jokes and points to real people; Settings, About has an If you need help now text. Peak makes no health claim. Full notes in CHANGELOG.md.
